definitions.source: Seed and arm are identified by the published totals filename. Individual SHA-256 digests bind the 200 files read by this analysis; the study separately validates historical annual ledger hashes.
definitions.units: Food measures are food units, labor is people per annual observation and worker-years when accumulated. Counts of deaths and residents are people. Rates are fractions, not percentages.
definitions.time: Annual is the named year; cumulative sums flows from year 1 through that year. Stocks, cash and population appear at their boundaries only. All cohort sums are over 20 worlds. Dividing sums by 20 gives a mean per world.
definitions.paired: Each difference is arm minus reference, computed within a seed. Paired means equally weight each defined seed, or each defined seed/country for the late national comparison. Lower unmet share means improvement; exact fractions classify direction and ties before rounding for JSON.
definitions.comparisons: All ten pairwise contrasts are provided. C versus A adds public harvests, D7/D14 versus C lower the reserve target, E versus C adds the emergency relief stage to C. Other contrasts can combine different mechanisms.
definitions.ratio: Cohort unmet share = sum(unmet)/sum(need), public days = 365*sum(closing public food)/sum(need). Undefined denominators give null. Absolute food eaten and a changing resident population are reported separately.
definitions.persistence: For every world and each country separately, years 151–200 must all meet 1, 7 or 14 days of closing public stock coverage with positive demand. A stricter count also requires closing stock in year 200 >= opening stock in year 151. Net drawdown is the opposite endpoint inequality. A zero-demand year leaves window persistence unclassified.
definitions.stock_exposure: Final resident food deficit is partitioned by positive public stocks immediately before supplemental relief: local, elsewhere in the same country only, or absent in that country. Shares divide by total final unmet food. Positive stock establishes overlap, not free or deliverable surplus. Closing-local exposure is a separate observation.
definitions.stages: Ordinary open gap = actual receipt + unauthorized + admin + budget + nondispatched residual. Emergency requested = receipt + handling + admin + stock + road + freight unfilled under the sequential stage rules. Reconciliations cover that stage only. Do not add them to final resident deficit or infer a meal from a delivery.
definitions.cases: Largest increase, largest decrease, and first tie in numerical seed/country order, or null if absent. Country counterexamples use summed late unmet/summed late need. Positive-reserve years with shortage are counts of world/country years and do not locate residents and stocks together within a region.
